Frequently Asked Questions

General Questions

How many times do you ship weekly?
We are ship up to 6 times a week. Express shipping days are every: Monday, Wednesday and Saturday. Regular service - every Tuesday, Friday and Sunday.
How long takes transit?
Express service from USA to Tbilisi takes three days (stoped), Regular service around 10-12 days.
Is it possible delay?
Unfortunately, the delay is possible. There are several reasons for the delay - the direct flight from the United States in Georgia does not exist, human error, weather or technical reasons which led to the postponement of the flight.
What should I do if I forgot to wright account number on the package?
In this case, the important thing is to add (make parcel declaration) the parcel in our system. After parcel scanning, the system will automatically reflect it in your account. Generally, it is not necessary to write the registration number of the total parcel is properly declared.
What is the volumetric weight?
No one likes the volume weight, including us. Would be much easier to put on a scale and not to measure, but ...

I'll try to explain: any airplane has the capacity (the maximum weight of the carriage), and space. For example, a passenger / cargo aircraft, which flies true transit countries (Turkey, Azerbaijan or Qatar) has a capacity of about 24 tons. In case, if the volume weight would no longer be a factor, and all forwarder companies will bring 24 tons (Volume) with actual weight of 13 tons the airline will lose 9 tons.

All airlines are paying for the flight performance a lot of fees, like: air and landing services, fuel and safety, licensing and aircraft depreciation, insurance and other costs to make each flight full workload.

Airlines that do not distinguish between its users according to the types of cargo and to serve, IATA- (International Air Transport Administration) introduced the volumetric weight formula, to be served everyone equally, according to that all consumers equally protected.

UPS, DHL, FedEX, USPS shows less weight than you website, why?
USA local carriers at most cases are transporting goods by land. In such cases, those website are showing real weight, but in case of air shipping, parcel volume weight is also important, because we pay to airlines same way.

If ever happens that we invoice you wrong, will apologize and correct pice.

Which type of payment do you accept?
We accept almost all type of payments: PayPal, Debit or credit card payment, checks, money orders, cash, bill pay (from you online banking), wire transfer, Chase quick Pay.

Payment forms from Georgia are: Web Pay from account, Mobile application, Credit card, PayPal, Wire Transfer; Cash

Haw can I truck my parcel?
There is two way to truck parcel:

1. Gzavnili's website – after visit of your virtual office you will have access on parcels, you can truck, pay, move to folder or archive. for parcel detail information just click on parcel trucking number and will see all parcel information from initial declaration to final signature capture.

2. Mobile application – iPhone, iPad and Android users can download our free application and truck yourself or activate push notification to get good news on the go. you will be able to be informed about any moving of your parcel.

Wy my parcel did not reflected on my account?
აHere may exist few reasons:
1. You did not declare (add to system) parcel correctly. You mast see your parcel anyway, if not it seams something wrong. Please fill-up all mandatory fields.
2. During parcel add process please make sure to enter correct informations. Please note: do not use order number instead of trucking. .
3. To show acceptance of parcel we may late for couple hours, because all parcels must be sorted out and reduced parcel size (in case of online shopping).. 4. If parcel did not reflected on your virtual Office even on next morning please contact us, its something wrong goes on.
Why merchant send to me one order in to shipments?
This sings happens with big merchants. If one warehouse missing some item from you order, merchant can ship in two parts.
How many days merchant need to deliver to your office?
Transit time to us depends on merchant good will or shipping method that your choose. In any case you can see estimate time of arrival on time of checkout.
